note: Ядро › Файли конфігів (VPP rework 2026-11-12, design §4.2): every config a module registered, by module and name, on the left; the file itself in an editor on the right; the Discord mirror switches under it -- one per mirrorable kind, generated; reload, paste from the clipboard, copy and apply at the bottom. Created by OZ_VppMenu.OnCreate; the shell moves it into the content area. Names RawList, RawEdit, MirrorStrip, RawHint, BtnRawReload, BtnRawPaste, BtnRawCopy and BtnRawApply are read by OZ_VppMenu.c.

frame.name: PaneRaw
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open tab's pane and hides the rest.

listbox.name: RawList
listbox.note: Every registered config, 'module · name': the files page of the whole window (design §1 item 5). A module's own rail entry opens it on that module's files.

field.name: RawEdit
field.note: The whole file, as text. 19 lines is what the 336-unit box holds at the fixed 14-point field face.

frame.name: MirrorStrip
frame.note: Empty: OZ_VppMenu fills it with one oz_vpp_mirror_row per kind mirror_list reports, so no mod's kind name lives in this repository. Here stood a fixed pair of switches named after the PDA's chat and the factions' roles -- a server with a third mod's kind could not reach it, and a server without the factions was offered a switch for a kind it does not have.

button.name: BtnRawPaste
button.note: Reads the clipboard by script and sets the whole text: the engine's own paste into an edit box stops at 512 bytes (design §4.2).

label.name: RawHint
label.note: Empty: every answer of the config route lands here.
